title: Measuring trogocytosis between ovarian tumor and natural killer cells
protocol: Immerse the TranswellTM -96 permeable support (upper plate) into the wells of the bottom plate.
Equilibrate in a humidified cell culture incubator, 37°C for at least 1 h before use.
Aliquot 125 μL of OVCAR4 cells (1 × 10^5 cells) into wells of a U-shaped bottom plate.
Place the equilibrated transwell membrane insert into the plate containing OVCAR4 cells.
Aliquot 125 μL of NK-92 cells (1 × 10^5 cells) into the transwells.
Incubate the dual chamber 96-well plate at 37°C for 6 hours.
Lift the transwell insert and place it in an empty sterile 96-well plate.
Release NK-92 cells from the membrane by gently pipetting up and down.
Pool cells from 10 transwells into 5 mL FACS tubes.
Process samples for CyTOF or fluorescence-based flow cytometry.
Coculture NK-92 and OVCAR4 cells in a humidified cell culture incubator, 37°C, for 15, 30, 60, 120, and 360 minutes.
Pre-treat NK-92 cells with concanamycin A at 100 nM for 2 hours at 37°C.
Incubate control NK-92 cells with vehicle only under the same conditions as treated samples.
Treat NK-92 cells with cytochalasin D at 10 μM for 2 hours at 37°C.
Pre-incubate NK-92 cells with EDTA at 2 mM for 2 hours at 37°C.
Incubate NK-92 cells in LY294002 at 10 μM for 2 hours at 37°C.
Treat NK-92 cells with nocodazole at 100 nM for 2 hours at 37°C.
Prepare 500 μL of target cells (HGSC or non-HGSC cell lines) in FACS tubes.
Mix 500 μL of pre-treated NK-92 cells with the target cells at a ratio of 1:1.
Centrifuge cocultures to maximize cell-cell contact at 200g for 2 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Incubate cocultures for 3 hours at 37°C.
Process inhibitor-treated cocultures for CyTOF or fluorescence cytometry as described in the protocol section before you begin.
Gate nucleated cells using DNA1 vs DNA2.
Select singlets based on DNA versus event length criteria.
Identify live cells by excluding cisplatin-positive cells.
Determine viable cells by excluding c-PARP-positive cells.
Isolate NK-92 cells by positive selection for CD45.
Gate the singlets population based on FSC-A vs FSC-H for fluorescence-based flow cytometry analysis.
Gate the cells population based on FSC-A vs SSC-A.
Gate the live cells population by staining with DAPI or Aqua and identifying DAPI-negative or Aqua-negative cells.
Gate the NK-92 cell population by detecting CD45+ cells.
Grow NK-92 and OVCAR4 cells in monoculture for analysis.
Stain cells grown in monoculture with cisplatin for live/dead cell staining.
Fix cells with PFA as per instructions provided in Section “before you begin” steps 16, 17, and 18.
Wash the cells with 4 mL of CSM buffer.
Centrifuge the washed cells at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cells in 90 μL of CSM buffer.
Incubate the resuspended cells with 5 μL Fc-Block for 10 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Add 5 μL of anti-CD9-phycoerythrin (PE) antibody to the incubated cells.
Incubate the cells on a shaker for 45 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Wash the cells once with 4 mL CSM buffer.
Centrifuge the washed cells again at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL of CSM buffer.
Incubate the resuspended cells with 1 μL anti-PE-165Ho antibody for 30 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Wash cells once with 4 mL CSM.
Centrifuge at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of ice-cold methanol and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Wash cells twice with 4 mL CSM.
Centrifuge at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL CSM containing 0.5 μL anti-CD9-156Gd antibody and incubate for 1 hour at 20°C–26°C.
Wash cells twice with 4 mL CSM.
Centrifuge at 500g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of freshly prepared DNA-iridium intercalator solution and incubate for 1 hour at 20°C–26°C or up to 48 hours at 4°C.
Introduce samples into mass cytometer.
Analyze FCS files.
Plot data.
Coculture OVCAR4 and NK-92 cells for 24 hours at 37°C.
Transfer the cell culture supernatant to FACS tubes.
Stain cells with fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies for FACS.
Resuspend cells in 90 μL of unsupplemented RPMI-1640.
Add 5 μL anti-human CD9-PE (2.5 μg/mL).
Add 5 μL anti-human CD45-APC (0.45 μg/mL).
Mix well and incubate protected from light for 30 min on ice.
Add 2 mL unsupplemented RPMI-1640 and centrifuge at 300g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash cells twice with 2 mL unsupplemented RPMI-1640, centrifuging at 300g for 5 min at 4°C each time.
Discard the supernatant after each wash.
Dilute DAPI (1 mg/mL) in unsupplemented RPMI-1640 to a final concentration of 0.1 μg/mL.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of the diluted DAPI solution.
Incubate protected from light for 10 min at 20°C–26°C.
Quench with 1 mL supplemented RPMI-1640 and centrifuge at 300g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash cells twice with 2 mL supplemented RPMI-1640, centrifuging at 300g for 5 min at 4°C each time.
Discard the supernatant after each wash.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of supplemented RPMI-1640.
Remove aggregates using a 35 μm cell strainer.
Sort gated cell populations using BD FACS Aria or Sony SH800.
Create gates for sorting using relevant software such as BD FACSDivaTM or Sony SH800.
For singlets, gate on forward scatter height (FSC-H) vs. forward scatter area (FSC-A).
For live cells (DAPI-negative), gate singlets on DAPI vs FSC-A.
For CD45+ NK-92 cells, gate live cells on CD45-APC vs FSC-A.
For CD9+ and CD9- NK-92 cells, gate CD45+ NK-92 cells on CD9-PE vs CD45-APC.
Sort using the purity mode to collect sorted CD9+ and CD9- NK-92 cells in ice-cold fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Centrifuge cell populations at 300g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of unsupplemented RPMI-1640.
Count the resuspended cells.
Include monocultures of both cell lines as controls: OVCAR4 cells stained with anti-human CD9-PE antibody, NK-92 cells unstained, and NK-92 cells stained with DAPI.
Perform all centrifugations at 4°C to minimize cell death.
Collect sorted CD9+ and CD9- NK-92 cells into ice-cold FBS in FACS tubes kept on ice and protected from light.
Use the RNeasy micro kit to isolate RNA from cell lysates.
Convert isolated RNA to cDNA using the High-Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription Kit.
Prepare cell lysates from monocultures of OVCAR4 and NK-92 cells as controls for CD9 transcripts presence or absence.
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend 2–5 × 10ˆ4 cells in 350 μL RLT buffer containing β-mercaptoethanol (10 μL/mL).
Lyse and homogenize cells according to the manufacturer’s protocol for the RNeasy kit.
Freeze the lysate at −80°C.
Perform RNA extraction according to the manufacturer’s protocol for the RNeasy kit.
Quantify RNA using a NanoDrop microvolume spectrophotometer.
Dilute RNA samples with RNAase-free water to 5–10 ng/μL.
Thaw kit components on ice.
Label PCR tubes and place them on ice.
Aliquot 12 μL of each RNA sample into PCR tubes on ice.
Prepare RT master mix by adding 4.8 μL RT buffer, 2.2 μL RNase free H2O, and 1 μL MultiScribe™ (RTase).
Add 8 μL master mix to each RNA sample for a final reaction volume of 20 μL.
Mix RT-PCR samples (triplicates) to include mRNAs from NK-92 cells in monoculture, FACS-purified CD9+ and CD9- NK-92 cells, OVCAR4 cells.
Include negative controls without RNA and without RTase respectively.
Make final reaction volumes up to 20 μL with RNase free H2O.
Keep samples on ice and gently pipette up and down to mix.
Load PCR tubes into a thermal cycler and set conditions according to High-Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription kit instructions.
Dilute cDNA (20 μL) by adding 60 μL ddH2O.
Label PCR tubes, place on ice and aliquot 12 μL of TaqMan qPCR master mix containing a VIC labeled probe against GAPDH and a FAM labeled probe against one gene of interest for each gene tested.
Add 8 μL cDNA to each PCR tube.
Pipette up and down with P20 pipette to mix well and avoid creating bubbles.
Transfer mix from PCR tubes to 384-well plate and seal it with aluminum sealing film.
Centrifuge 384-well plate, 300g, for 2 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Load 384-well plate onto a 7900HT Fast Real-Time PCR System.
Analyze data from the PCR system.
Plot transcript copy numbers relative to GAPDH control.
Label OVCAR4 cells with PKH67 dye.
Prepare monocultures of OVCAR4 and NK-92 cells at a concentration of 2.5 × 10^6 cells/mL in specified media.
Harvest OVCAR4 cells.
Resuspend harvested cells in unsupplemented RPMI-1640 and transfer to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add diluent C for cell suspension (final concentration of 1 × 10^7 cells/mL).
Mix an equal volume of PKH67 working solution with the OVCAR4 cell suspension (final concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Incubate the mixture at 20°C–26°C for 5 minutes.
Quench the labeling reaction by adding an equal volume of filtered FBS and incubating for 1 minute at 20°C–26°C.
Centrifuge the labeled cells at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash cells with 10 mL of supplemented RPMI-1640 three times, centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C each time.
Resuspend labeled OVCAR4 cells in supplemented RPMMI-1640 + IL-2 (final concentration of 2.5 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Keep the resuspended cells protected from light before setting up coculture.
Seed PKH67-stained OVCAR4 cells with unstained NK-92 cells for coculture at specified effector:target ratios in a 96-well U-bottom plate.
Centrifuge the 96-well plate at 250g for 4 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Incubate the coculture in a humidified cell culture incubator for 24 hours at 37°C.
Pipette the cocultured cells up and down before transferring them from wells to FACS tubes.
Centrifuge the cells at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells with PBS, centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Perform live/dead cell staining as per the specified protocol steps.
Conduct antibody staining according to the detailed instructions provided.
Prepare the cells for fluorescence-based flow cytometry following the outlined procedure.
Harvest monocultures of OVCAR4 cells as per the protocol steps 13.a.–k..
Label 2 × 10^6 OVCAR4 cells with PKH67 dye.
Resuspend labeled OVCAR4 cells in supplemented RPMI-1640 at a concentration of 0.8 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Seed labeled OVCAR4 cells (125 μL/well) in 96-well U-bottom plate for coculture with NK-92 cells using an effector : target ratio of 1 : 1.
Seed a row of 10 wells per condition.
Harvest NK-92 cell monocultures.
Resuspend cells in unsupplemented RPMI-1640 and transfer 2 × 10^6 NK-92 cells to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C, discard supernatant.
Prepare a cell suspension of 1 × 10^7 cells/mL in diluent C.
Label NK-92 cell suspension with an equal volume of 40 μM PKH26 solution to achieve a final concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL at 20°C–26°C.
Mix well by pipetting up and down, incubate for 5 minutes at 20°C–26°C.
Quench labeling by adding an equal volume of filtered FBS and incubating for 1 minute at 20°C–26°C.
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C, discard supernatant.
Wash cells three times with 10 mL of supplemented RPMI-1640, centrifuging each time at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend labeled NK-92 cells in supplemented RPMI-1640 with IL-2 (400 IU/mL) to achieve a concentration of 0.8 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add 125 μL of labeled NK-92 cells to 96-well U-bottom plate containing OVCAR4 target cells.
Centrifuge the 96-well plate at 250g for 4 minutes at 20°C–26°C and incubate coculture in a humidified cell culture incubator at 37°C for 3 hours.
Transfer 15 μL onto a microscope slide.
Let it dry.
Add one drop of Fluoromount mounting medium to cells on the microscope slide.
Place a coverslip on top of the slide and press gently.
Carefully remove excess mounting agent by blotting with a Kimwipe.
Dry for 5 minutes.
Image on a microscope, e.g., Keyence BZ-X800.
